market_outlook.short_term: Markets rallied post-Fed hike, suggesting the move was anticipated. Near-term volatility elevated by BOJ dissent, yen weakness, and Trump-Fed friction. Commodities supported by Chinese demand. Watch for stagflation narrative to gain traction if oil rebounds. 1-3 month: range-bound equities with sector rotation into energy, metals, and value.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month: Fed tightening cycle likely 1-2 more hikes given RBA-style 'is it enough?' debate. Stagflation risk is the primary macro threat. AI regulation will reshape tech valuations. Vietnam and EM upgrades offer structural inflows. Tesla's global EV expansion and Amazon's infrastructure buildout are multi-year themes. Consumer financial stress may cap discretionary spending through 2027.
